findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1, so existing callers that did not pass `min` now get a floor of 1 second on every wait, even where the previous result was below 1 second.
findings.rationale: Trigger: wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1) or any configuration whose computed wait is under 1s, with min left at its default. Before this change the wait was max(0, min(result, max)), so it could be 0.1s. After it, max(max(0, 1), min(result, max)) forces at least 1s. Impact: callers who relied on sub-second backoff silently wait longer, and total retry time changes with no opt-in. The title announces a new min parameter, not a changed default, so the default-value change is not covered by it.
